inputs.text: It's the same tired pattern we've seen play out whenever societies cast aside personal responsibility and the traditional standards of integrity that built stable communities and strong nations. South African actress Terry Pheto is once again mired in controversy over alleged financial misconduct involving R20.56 million from the National Lotteries Commission in an SIU probe, with these details laid out during a briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026. This is exactly the kind of rot that spreads when we trade our time-honored values and national foundations for unaccountable modern institutions that chip away at social order and cultural continuity.
